_source: THE APPRECIATION AT THE HEAD OF THIS ROOM IS BUILT OUT OF ONE PAGE OF OURS: https://stimpunks.org/glossary/rest/, read out of the Knowledge System mirror on 2026-09-22 rather than fetched live, because on stimpunks.org a 301 is a failure and not a pass. Every quoted line below is on that page, every attribution below is the one that page makes, and the two things on it that this room does NOT reproduce are listed in `held` with the reason, rather than quietly left out.
_short: NOTHING QUOTED HERE RUNS PAST THIRTY WORDS, which is make-zibaldone.py's limit and is enforced again here. That tool's reasoning applies exactly: nobody ever decides to republish somebody else's page. They add one good line, then another, each individually reasonable, and a year later the room IS the source instead of pointing at it. There is no moment anybody could have caught, so it is a number in a tool rather than a habit.
_not_instrumental: THE REFUSAL THIS ROOM EXISTS FOR, and it is the one nothing else on this street makes. Star Stuff's zine No. 58 refuses 'rest so you can produce' in as many words, and the otter cabinet already holds that line for one game. This is the room where the whole street says it. So make-checkpoint.py sweeps every published string here for instrumental rest -- earn, deserve, recharge, so you can, in order to, productive, bounce back, back to work, optimise -- and stops the build. The friendly edit is real and it will arrive, because EVERY wellness page on the internet is written the other way: rest is good FOR something. A room arguing that rest is owed cannot carry one sentence saying what it is for.
_no_tally: Nothing in this room is counted. No total, no streak, no minutes rested, no memory between visits, nothing written to storage at all -- which is the pebbling cabinet's refusal of a tally and the guild's refusal of a score, arriving in the room where a counter would be the most obvious improvement anybody could suggest. A checkpoint that remembered you would be keeping a record of how often you needed one.

held.what: Three illustrations of Disabled people resting — a sleepover across two beds, somebody with idiopathic hypersomnia asleep in the afternoon light, a couple asleep at 3:42 in the morning

_trail: THE TRAIL IS THE REST ENTRY’S OWN FURTHER READING LIST, in that page’s order, and make-checkpoint.py refuses an entry that is not on stimpunks.org. That is make-rabbit-hole.py’s rule and make-hermitage.py’s before it: a list built out of somebody else’s Further Reading, with something extra slipped into it, is this room quietly extending a list it does not keep. There are other pages of ours about rest and they are linked in the prose instead, where they are plainly our choice rather than that page’s.
